plugin.name: Language Models
plugin.description: More model providers for the agent, each with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds model providers to Settings → Providers. Enter a provider's API key here or in Settings and its models appear in the model menu; the list is read from the provider, so new models show up by themselves. A provider without a key stays out.
config.commandCode.title: Command Code API key
config.commandCode.description: From Command Code Studio → Settings → API Keys, on the Provider plan. Claude models are only served through Command Code's own protocol and aren't listed.
